description: This file defines the LocalizationController class, which manages localization settings for the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It extends a base controller, integrates localization services via traits, and prepares Vue.js components with localization data during the rendering process.

classes.name: LocalizationController
classes.description: Controller for managing localization configuration, extending from AbstractVueController and utilizing localization service traits.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares localization data and Vue component before rendering, setting properties like supported languages and date formats.
